create_Detectron2Segmentation: create a Detectron2Segmentation instance with a confidence threshold, GPU id, and visualization flag
run_Detectron2Segmentation_get_predictio: run get_prediction on batched BGR images with optional depth frames to get one-hot segmentation masks
build_ImageSegmentation: build an ImageSegmentation model using Mask R-CNN with a configurable confidence threshold and GPU device
run_BatchPredictor: run the BatchPredictor on a batch of BGR images to get Detectron2 instance segmentation predictions
review_VisualizationDemo_run_on_images: review the VisualizationDemo run_on_images method that returns predictions and optional visualizations for batched images
